clusters.name: worktree-conditional-submodule-init
clusters.executionModeRationale: Tightly-coupled change across a small surface. Tests (US-002/US-003) depend on the runtime flags (US-001 adds both --no-submodule-init and --require-submodule-init). Copilot mirrors (US-004) regenerate from plan-with-ralph + convert-to-ralph-prd SKILL.md edits in one generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --write pass. AGENTS.md (US-005) and the 5-stamp version bump (US-006) land in the same toolkit topic-branch commit as US-001-005 (US-007 is the toolkit-handoff gate). Codexu pointer bump (US-008) depends on US-007's SHA existing on a pushed toolkit topic branch. Smoke (US-009) depends on lead-FF + multi-remote sync completing for both repos. Serializing is correct; parallelism would conflict on every modified file.
